statement: On cejel's v27 B3 fourth pass, disabling one refusal at a time showed three that no fixture could make load-bearing (a Makefile directive list, a Pipfile section list, a same-line order test): a broader rule already enforced each, so they were dropped. Two fixtures were excluded for the wrong reason: a vite-build refusal fixture lacked the tsconfig.json the credited one had, and a mutation writing `npm test || true` in the publishing step made the publish itself conditional, so the workflow was no longer read as publishing. Rules: disable each named refusal and drop it if no fixture fails; a refusal fixture differs from a credited one only in the property that refusal checks; a mutation of a credit path keeps every upstream classification unchanged.
